notes: barn_03 silo banner is a tone-on-tone gold sun on a gold field (emblem on its own colour, a rule breach) and does not match the castle sun emblem; barn_02 (blue) has a hay-thatch roof, so blue reads only from the doors and one banner at 74 studs. All four repeat the same front dressing (hoist and bale, lantern, sack, bale stack), but the roof forms (gambrel, thatch, silo, wide gable) keep the silhouettes distinct.
